SELECT s.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, s.score2020 AS score2020, s.rank2020 AS rank2020, s.score2021 AS score2021, s.rank2021 AS rank2021, s.score2022 AS score2022, s.rank2022 AS rank2022, si.province_name AS provinceName, si.is985 AS is985, si.is211 AS is211, si.doublehigh AS doublehigh, si.month_view AS monthView, si.total_view AS totalView FROM sc_li_score s LEFT JOIN school_info si ON s.school_id = si.school_id WHERE #{upperRank} <= ((s.rank2020 + s.rank2021 + s.rank2022) / 3) AND ((s.rank2020 + s.rank2021 + s.rank2022) / 3) <= #{lowerRank}
AND si.province_name IN
#{p}
AND si.is985 = '985'
AND si.is211 = '211'
AND si.doublehigh = '双一流'
ORDER BY ((s.rank2020 + s.rank2021 + s.rank2022) / 3) DESC
